title: Sr Engr Cslt-AI Science
description:
When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
As a
**Senior Engineer Consultant - AI Science**
, you will architect, build, and deploy production-grade Generative AI, Agentic workflows, and Advanced NLP systems for enterprise clients. You will bridge the gap between applied research and enterprise engineering—translating ambiguous business requirements into robust, high-performance AI architectures. You will guide business from proof-of-concept (PoC) to scalable production, establish technical governance, and mentor emerging AI talent.
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  

* Architect & Deliver End-to-End Solutions: Design, prototype, benchmark, and deploy enterprise-grade Agentic systems, multi-stage RAG pipelines, and fine-tuned Foundation/Small Language Model (LLM/SLM) architectures to solve complex business problems.
* Lead AI Engineering & Productionization: Implement modern LLMOps/GenAIOps standards, including prompt orchestration, deterministic guardrails, structured outputs, automated red-teaming, latency/token-cost optimization, and continuous evaluation (e.g., LLM-as-a-judge).
* Execute High-Impact Fine-Tuning & Quantization: Conduct parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT/LoRA/QLoRA), alignment tuning (DPO, RLHF), and model quantization/distillation for downstream domain specialization and edge/on-premise inference.
* Drive Client Advisory & Executive Communication: Partner with cross-functional global stakeholders, translate complex algorithmic decisions into measurable business impact (ROI, cost-per-query, latency budgets), and deliver compelling technical presentations to C-suite leadership.
* Practice Growth & Technical Evangelism: Lead technical proposals (RFPs/POCs), formulate point-of-view (PoV) whitepapers, explore emerging frontier models and open-source tooling, and continuously enhance internal IP, reference architectures, and reusable accelerators.
* Mentorship & Technical Leadership: Foster engineering excellence by conducting rigorous code/design reviews, guiding junior scientists on applied ML/GenAI methodologies, and enforcing reproducible data science standards.

What We Are Looking For
  
  
You are an applied AI practitioner and pragmatic engineer who thrives on turning raw research and frontier models into secure, reliable software systems. You balance algorithmic depth with system architecture, understand the operational bottlenecks and scaling best practices and are able to own technical delivery at scale end to end.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Education & Experience: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, paired with 4+ years of hands-on experience in applied machine learning, deep learning, and advanced NLP/GenAI in an enterprise or consulting environment.
* GenAI & Agentic Architectures: Deep hands-on experience building autonomous agents and complex multi-agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel) using tool-calling, stateful memory, and routing graphs.
* Advanced RAG & Retrieval Systems: Demonstrated expertise implementing hybrid search pipelines (dense vectors + sparse BM25), semantic routing, contextual compression, reranking models (e.g., Cohere, BGE), and production vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus, pgvector).
* Fine-Tuning & Model Adaptation: Practical experience fine-tuning open-source LLMs/SLMs (e.g., Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Phi) using PEFT, LoRA/QLoRA, DeepSpeed, or Unsloth, paired with robust knowledge of post-training evaluation frameworks (e.g., Ragas, DeepEval, TruLens).
* Software Engineering & APIs: Strong proficiency in Python, modern asynchronous web frameworks (FastAPI), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and designing secure, low-latency REST/gRPC endpoints.
* Cloud & Distributed Computing: Hands-on experience architecting ML/AI workloads on at least one major cloud platform (AWS SageMaker/Bedrock, Azure OpenAI/ML, or GCP Vertex AI).

Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
  
  
Scheduled Weekly Hours
  
  
40
  
  
Equal Employment Opportunity
  
  
Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: AIML Engineer Digital & AI
description:
**Company Description**
**ABOUT IQ-EQ**
We’re a leading Investor Services group offering end-to-end services in administration, accounting, reporting, regulatory and compliance needs of the investment sector worldwide.  We employ a global workforce of 6,500+ people across 24 jurisdictions and have assets under administration (AUA) exceeding US$857 billion. We work with 13 of the world’s top-15 private equity firms.
  
  
Our services are underpinned by a Group-wide commitment to ESG and best-in-class technology including a global data platform and innovative proprietary tools supported by in-house experts.
  
  
Above all, what makes us different is our people. Operating as trusted partners to our clients, we deliver intelligent solutions through a combination of technical expertise and strong relationships based on deep client understanding.
  
  
We’re driven by our Group purpose, to power people and possibilities.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Introduction**
Join our Digital & AI team as an Engineer, Digital & AI Solutions, where you will design, develop, and deliver innovative AI-driven solutions that create business value. You will work with cross-functional teams to build scalable digital products, leverage emerging technologies, and drive continuous innovation across the organization.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* You'll design, develop, and deploy digital and AI solutions, including AI/ML systems, LLMs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), NLP applications, computer vision systems, predictive analytics, and advanced machine learning models.
* You'll provide technical leadership to developers, data scientists, and engineers, ensuring successful project delivery within scope, budget, quality, and timeline requirements.
* You'll collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements, identify innovation opportunities, and translate complex technical concepts into actionable business solutions.
* You'll establish and maintain best practices for software development, quality assurance, security, scalability, and reliability, utilizing technologies such as Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, transfer learning, LLMs, and AWS Bedrock.
* You'll drive continuous improvement by monitoring solution performance, optimizing processes, ensuring compliance with policies and regulations, and providing technical guidance and thought leadership across the organization.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive Total Rewards Package: Comprehensive annual compensation including basic salary, HRA, special allowance, provident fund, gratuity, internet allowance, and food allowance.
* Health & Insurance Coverage: Medical insurance, group term life insurance, and personal accident insurance.
* Allowances & Support: Transportation/transport allowance and shift allowance.
* Paid Time Off: Generous leave policy to support work–life balance.

**Qualifications**
**About you**

* You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field and have at least 2 years of experience delivering AI projects from concept to production.
* You possess strong technical expertise in AI, machine learning, deep learning, reinforcement learning, natural language processing, cloud computing, big data analytics, web and mobile technologies, and IoT.
* You are proficient in Python, Java, or C++ and have hands-on experience with frameworks and platforms such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, Keras, LLMs, transfer learning, and AWS Bedrock.
* You demonstrate excellent communication, problem-solving, and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* You are a collaborative team player with strong leadership capabilities and experience working in Agile/Scrum environments; relevant certifications (AWS, Azure AI, etc.) and exposure to global teams, financial services, or private equity environments are advantageous.

**Additional Information**
**OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU AND THE ENVIRONMENT**
Sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations. Our sustainability depends on us building and maintaining long-term relationships with all our stakeholders – including our employees, clients, and local communities – while also reducing our impact on our natural environment.
  
  
There is always more we can, and should do, to improve – whether in relation to our people, our clients, our planet, or our governance. Our ongoing success as a business depends on our sustainability and agility in a changing and challenging global landscape. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable and diverse culture for our people, led by our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion steering committee.
  
  
Our learning and development programmes and systems (including PowerU and MyCampus) enable us to invest in growing our employees’ careers, while our hybrid working approach supports our employees in achieving balance and flexibility while remaining connected to their colleagues. We want to empower our 6,500+ employees - from 94 nationalities, across 24 countries - to each achieve their potential. Through IQ-EQ Launchpad we support women managers launching their first fund, in an environment where only 15% of all private equity and venture capital firms are gender balanced.
  
  
We’re committed to growing relationships with our clients and supporting them in achieving their objectives. We understand that our clients’ sustainability and success lead to our sustainability and success. We’re emotionally invested in our clients right from the beginning.

You will own the end-to-end lifecycle of critical AI models while translating complex technical results into compelling business narratives for finance leadership.
  
  

* Design and deploy core AI/ML and Generative AI solutions to optimize financial operations.
* Build and orchestrate Agentic AI workflows to automate multi-step financial analysis and decision-making processes.
* Utilize foundational models and AI assistants (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot) to rapidly prototype, iterate, and deliver agile AI solutions to meet dynamic business needs.
* Engineer robust data pipelines and write complex SQL/BigQuery queries to extract and transform large-scale financial datasets using GCP and Python.
* Act as a data storyteller—synthesizing complex AI/ML model outputs into clear, actionable, and prescriptive insights for non-technical finance stakeholders.
* Design, develop, and optimize Artificial Intelligence, NLP, SLM/LLM solutions to diverse real-world problems.
* Implement MLOps best practices to ensure continuous integration, deployment, and monitoring of financial AI models in production environments.
* Driving data-derived insights across the business domain by developing advanced statistical models, machine learning algorithms and computational algorithms based on business initiatives.

**What We’re Looking For...**
Your primary focus will be transforming traditional financial operations into a proactive, AI-driven organization. You are a hands-on builder who thrives at the intersection of core ML, cutting-edge GenAI, and business strategy. You have a knack for rapid prototyping and possess the communication skills required to explain the "why" and "how" of AI to business leaders.
  
  
**You'll Need To Have**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field
* Three or more years of relevant professional work experience.
* Three or more years of experience practicing data science, AI engineering, or machine learning, with a strong focus on core AI/ML, GenAI, and Agentic frameworks.
* Experience with all phases of end-to-end Analytics project, such as (but not limited to): Ingestion, Munging, Model Building, Validation, Operationalization, Monitoring
* Strong programming proficiency in Python and advanced SQL.
* Proven experience working within cloud platforms (Teradata/ GCP) and using tools like BigQuery for large-scale data processing.
* Demonstrated experience in rapid prototyping and building solutions leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot).
* Hands-on familiarity with specific Agentic AI and orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex).
* Exceptional data storytelling and communication skills, with a proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into confident financial business decisions.

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Advanced degree (Master’s) in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, or a related field.
* Prior experience in the telecommunications industry specifically dealing with financial data, billing systems, FinOps, revenue assurance.
* Experience in designing and deploying end-to-end MLOps and LLMOps pipelines.
* A strong understanding of financial forecasting models, anomaly detection algorithms, and time-series analysis.

**Why Verizon?**
Verizon is committed to maintaining a Total Rewards package which is competitive, valued by our employees, and differentiates us as an Employer of Choice.
  
  

* We are a ‘pay for performance’ company and your contribution is rewarded through competitive salaries and performance-based incentives. We create an opportunity for us all to share in the success of Verizon and the value we help to create through this broad-based discretionary equity award program.
* Your benefits are market competitive and delivered by some of the best providers.
* You are provided with a full spectrum of health and wellbeing resources, including a first in-class Employee Assistance Program, to empower you to make positive health decisions.
* We offer generous paid time off benefits to help you manage your work life balance and opportunities for flexible working arrangements\*.
* Verizon provides training and development for all levels, to help you enhance your skills and develop your career, from funding towards education assistance, award-winning training, online development tools and access to industry research.
* You will be able to take part in volunteering opportunities as part of our environmental, community and sustainability commitment.

Your benefits package will vary depending on the country in which you work.
  
  

* subject to business approval

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.

40

title: Sr. Engineer - Data Engineering
description:
**About Us**
Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience in the United States (U.S.) across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.
  
  
At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected - and empowered - to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.
  
  
**Why We Do What We Do**
In the U.S., consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.
  
  
Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. The local team contributes to the development and implementation of innovative solutions, ensuring that technology and processes are optimized for efficiency and effectiveness. Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award-winning culture.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer with strong hands-on experience in Snowflake and dbt to design, build, and optimize scalable cloud data solutions. The ideal candidate will have expertise in developing ELT pipelines, dimensional/data modeling, SQL optimization, and implementing reliable data transformation frameworks using dbt. The role requires close collaboration with data engineering, analytics, and business teams to deliver high-quality, governed, and performant data products.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and data models using Snowflake and dbt.
* Build reusable and maintainable dbt models, macros, tests, snapshots, and incremental models.
* Develop complex SQL transformations and optimize Snowflake queries for performance and cost.
* Design data models following dimensional modeling and modern data warehouse best practices.
* Implement automated data-quality checks, testing, documentation, and lineage using dbt.
* Work with Snowflake features including warehouses, databases/schemas, stages, streams/tasks, roles, and access controls.
* Troubleshoot data pipeline failures, performance issues, and data-quality problems.
* Participate in code reviews and establish engineering standards for SQL and dbt development.
* Collaborate with upstream/downstream teams to understand data requirements and deliver reliable datasets.
* Support CI/CD and automated deployment processes for dbt projects across environments.

**Required Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake.
* Strong hands-on experience with dbt (Data Build Tool).
* Advanced SQL and strong understanding of query optimization.
* Experience designing and implementing ELT/data transformation pipelines.
* Strong understanding of data warehousing, dimensional modeling, fact/dimension tables, and SCD concepts.
* Experience with Git and CI/CD development practices.
* Experience implementing data quality, testing, monitoring, and documentation.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with Python for data engineering and automation.
* Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow.
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
* Experience with dbt Cloud, including jobs, environments, deployments, and CI.
* Familiarity with Snowflake security, RBAC, performance tuning, and cost optimization.

**Ideal Experience:**
5+ years in Data Engineering, including significant hands-on experience with Snowflake and dbt.
  
  
**Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging**
At Zelis, we champion diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our operations. We embrace the power of diversity and create an environment where people can bring their authentic and best selves to work. We know that a sense of belonging is key not only to your success at Zelis, but also to your ability to bring your best each day.
  
  
**Equal Employment Opportunity**
Zelis is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
  
  
**Accessibility Support**
We are dedicated to ensuring our application process is accessible to all candidates. If you are a qualified individual with a disability and require reasonable accommodation with any part of the application and/or interview process, please email talentacquisition@zelis.com.

title: Health Economics Associate
description:
**About Parexel**
Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
  
  
We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose – moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart®.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Health Economics Analyst to join our team.As a Health Economics Analyst, you will contribute to the development of health economic models that evaluate the cost-effectiveness of health technologies for global reimbursement applications. This position plays a key role in advancing the economic evidence that supports patient access to innovative therapies worldwide. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams including clinical, regulatory, and commercial partners, follow industry-standard processes, and contribute to project execution from model conceptualization through final delivery.
  
  
Responsibilities include data analysis, model building support, and assisting senior team members in project execution, with opportunities to deepen your expertise in health economics and expand your skills across clinical research and outcomes analysis. You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through rigorous economic evaluation and strategic reimbursement solutions. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Health Economics Analyst can explore career paths and expand skills across health economics, outcomes research, and global market access.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Perform comprehensive data analysis to support health economic model development and validation
* Assist in building and adapting health economic models for country-specific applications and reimbursement requirements
* Conduct systematic searches for published health economic models and Health Technology Assessment (HTA) body guidance to inform model development
* Check and validate health economic models using appropriate software tools to ensure accuracy and elucidate the economic value of clients' products
* Support senior team members in project execution, including model documentation, quality assurance, and deliverable preparation
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand client needs and translate requirements into model specifications
* Maintain high standards of scientific accuracy and attention to detail in all analytical work and documentation
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of health economic modeling processes and methodologies

**You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring**

* Strong analytical ability and attention to detail in complex quantitative work
* Advanced computing skills, particularly in Microsoft Excel with proficiency in macros and VBA
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, especially in conveying technical information clearly
* Experience working in healthcare, pharmaceutical, or regulated research environments
* Self-motivation, enthusiasm, and flexibility in a dynamic project-based setting
* Keen interest in medical research, healthcare delivery, and the pharmaceutical industry

**Required Qualifications**

* Master's degree or equivalent in a life science or quantitative discipline (health economics, economics, mathematics, statistics, or related field)
* Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel
* High analytical ability and strong written accuracy
